description: This Java source file contains integration tests for MQTT connection handling in the Eclipse Hono project. It tests various connection scenarios such as successful connection with credentials or certificates, and various failure modes including unknown devices, disabled tenants, and disabled credentials.

classes.name: MqttConnectionIT
classes.description: Integration test class for MQTT connection scenarios in the Eclipse Hono project, extending MqttTestBase and utilizing Vertx testing extensions.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Sets up test fixtures including tenant, device ID, password, and device certificate before each test.

methods.name: testConnectSucceedsForRegisteredDevice
methods.description: Test that a registered device can successfully connect with valid credentials.

methods.name: testConnectX509SucceedsForRegisteredDevice
methods.description: Test that a device with a valid X.509 certificate can successfully connect.

methods.name: testConnectFailsForNonExistingDevice
methods.description: Test that connection is refused for an unregistered device.

methods.name: testConnectX509FailsForNonExistingDevice
methods.description: Test that connection is refused for an unregistered device attempting to connect with a certificate.

methods.name: testConnectFailsForWrongCredentials
methods.description: Test that connection fails when providing wrong credentials.

methods.name: testConnectX509FailsForUnknownSubjectDN
methods.description: Test that connection is refused when device presents a certificate with an unknown subject DN.

methods.name: testConnectFailsForDisabledAdapter
methods.description: Test that connection is refused due to the MQTT adapter being disabled for the tenant.

methods.name: testConnectX509FailsForDisabledAdapter
methods.description: Test that connection with a client certificate is refused when the tenant's MQTT adapter is disabled.

methods.name: testConnectFailsForDisabledCredentials
methods.description: Test that connection fails when device credentials are disabled.

methods.name: testConnectFailsForDisabledDevice
methods.description: Test that connection fails when the device itself is disabled.

methods.name: testConnectFailsForDisabledTenant
methods.description: Test that connection fails for a tenant that is disabled.

methods.name: testConnectX509FailsForDisabledTenant
methods.description: Test that connection with X.509 certificate is refused for a disabled tenant.
